art_direction: 一眼浅拱、一眼短平后下弯，下轮廓不闭合，双瞳微抬，短眉略不齐。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two eyes with economical pen lines. One upper contour is a shallow arch; the other briefly flattens before curving down. Leave both lower contours incomplete. Large beanlike black pupils look together slightly upward, interrupted by broad irregular patches of untouched paper. Place a flat iris accent inside each opening. Include two short uneven eyebrow strokes, no mouth. Keep the centered drawing loose, using small changes in line pressure instead of added scratches or repeated sketch lines.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
